objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object (policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, etc.) that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning and archiving lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level in the document pyramid (Level 1–4).

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation used in the document naming convention (e.g. RL for guideline).

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Cross-client 4-digit sequential number per document type.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Descriptive title of the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. Editing, Released, Out of Force).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid, calculated from Valid From plus validity period.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Configurable period for validity review, default 3 years.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Configurable retention period after invalidation, default 10 years.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Original file format of the document content (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Language of the document content.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to related master data, IT applications, or other documents.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or areas of validity assigned to the document.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Specification of in which clients the document is visible in a multi-client system.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document linked to a main document that is subject to its own versioning and is released together with the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the attachment.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary document added to a main document that is not subject to the release cycle and can be published directly.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status (e.g. published or not).

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A formal request to amend an existing released document, created by users with author rights without affecting the current document version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request triggered 30 days before a document's validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the validity extension request.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate a released document and archive it, withdrawing it from circulation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the override request.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated (archived) document, created only by the Business Admin group.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the reactivation request.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new document objects.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person in the system who can hold one or more roles (author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, reader) on a document.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the user.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A named group of users used to assign read or change authorizations and distribution membership.

attributes.name: group_name
attributes.description: Name identifying the user group (e.g. Reader - Document Management, Archive).

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of user groups and individual persons maintained per document to control notification and acknowledgement upon release.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by e-mail or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A digital signature applied by workflow participants to confirm completion of a workflow step.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: Identity of the person who signed.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the signature was applied.

attributes.name: workflow_step
attributes.description: The step in the release process the signature corresponds to.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process instance managing the steps of document release, validity extension, override, reactivation, or acknowledgement.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: Type of workflow (e.g. release, validity extension, override, reactivation, acknowledgement).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the workflow instance.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is attached in the system with selection of document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type_selected
attributes.description: The document type chosen during creation.

attributes.name: template_selected
attributes.description: The template chosen during creation, if any.

evts.name: edit_metadata
evts.description: The properties and metadata attributes of a document are maintained or modified.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: The metadata category being edited (e.g. Master data, Control).

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the integrated editing client in the corresponding Office application.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: The saved document is automatically converted to PDF format by the system for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The approval process (Creator–Review–Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first workflow step (Creator).

evts.name: sign_review_step
evts.description: A reviewer completes the review step with an electronic signature, confirming technical or formal check.

attributes.name: review_result
attributes.description: Positive approval or rejection.

evts.name: sign_release_step
evts.description: A releaser completes the release step with an electronic signature to finally release the document.

attributes.name: release_result
attributes.description: Positive approval or rejection.

evts.name: reject_in_review
evts.description: A reviewer rejects the document during the review step, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided for the rejection.

evts.name: reject_in_release
evts.description: A releaser rejects the document during the release step, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided for the rejection.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and made visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created due to content changes, attribute changes, attachment changes, or change proposal implementation.

attributes.name: trigger
attributes.description: The reason for the new version (content change, attribute change, attachment change, change proposal).

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: A new controlled attachment is added to a document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving; actual archiving occurs upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is added to a document without affecting its version or release cycle.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is removed from a document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author creates a change proposal for an existing released document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the associated document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of the change proposal; the creator is notified and the proposal is no longer displayed.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system automatically creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the document validity expires.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: The validity extension request is processed via workflow; validity is extended or revision/override is decided.

attributes.name: decision
attributes.description: Outcome: extend validity, revise, or override.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The document validity (Valid Until date) is updated by the default period and the request is deleted.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate (override) a document.

evts.name: process_override
evts.description: The override request is processed through the workflow (by releaser or by initiator, reviewer, releaser).

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The document is declared out of force; the last released version is archived and all rights except archive group are revoked.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: A Business Admin group member creates a request to reactivate an invalidated document.

evts.name: process_reactivation
evts.description: The reactivation request is confirmed by the initiator via workflow, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: The invalidated document is restored with a new version, original metadata, authorizations and attachments.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are notified by e-mail upon release of a new document version.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are requested to actively confirm acknowledgement upon document release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of a released document version via workflow task.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or change authorizations are assigned to user groups or individual persons for a document.

attributes.name: authorization_type
attributes.description: Type of authorization assigned (read, write).

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: A released document is translated into another language by a translator.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language the document is being translated into.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A translated version of a document is reviewed and released via workflow, making it visible in the corresponding login language.

o2o.description: An attachment belongs to and is controlled by a main document.
Additional information is supplementary to a main document.
A change proposal belongs to and is displayed within a specific document.
A validity extension request is linked to the document whose validity is being checked.
An override request is created for a specific document to be invalidated.
A reactivation request references the invalidated document to be reactivated.
A document template is associated with a document type and can be selected when creating documents.
A distribution list is maintained per document to control notification and acknowledgement.
A user is assigned to one or more user groups which determine their system roles and authorizations.
User groups are assigned to distribution lists to define notification and acknowledgement recipients.
Individual persons can be directly assigned to a distribution list.
Documents can reference other documents via the References attribute.
